column6: comment -- tables of 16 bit pointers; kind = data (pointers to data) or code (pointers to routines)

column1: # target_bank: bank the pointers lead into when they are >= $4000 (0 = same as the table)

column6: RoomMetatileTable: metatile definitions per room theme (index = (round-1)&15; 16 = bonus)
RoomSpriteSetTable: source of the second sprite tile set in bank 2
RoomMapTable: packed 2 bit room maps (64 bytes each)
RoomVramJobTable: VRAM copy jobs per room
EnemySlotTable: addresses of the 16 enemy slots in WRAM
EnemyBehaviorTable: routine run by UpdateEnemy indexed by $ffd2
SoundCommandDataTable: song or effect data start per sound id ($81-$93; $8c is an empty slot that points at padding)
SoundCommandHandlerTable: routine that starts each sound id (music type $4263; effect type $4292)
